verdict.rationale: The evidence shows single-step conversions via the web UI, the API, a CLI and OCR, with per-conversion settings. Nothing documents chaining convert, optimize and deliver steps into one job, and nothing documents a watched-folder workflow. A file-conversion service could plausibly offer multi-step pipelines, so the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can chain steps (convert, then optimize, then deliver) into one job or watched workflow
